python3 -c "
import subprocess, time
t0 = time.perf_counter()
p = subprocess.run(['python3', 'csvsum.py'], stdin=open('data.csv', 'rb'), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
if p.returncode != 0:
    print(0); raise SystemExit()
out = p.stdout.decode().strip().splitlines()
exp = open('expected.txt').read().strip().splitlines()
if len(out) != len(exp):
    print(0); raise SystemExit()
for o, e in zip(out, exp):
    co, vo = o.split(',')
    ce, ve = e.split(',')
    if co != ce or '.' not in vo or len(vo.split('.')[1]) != 2 or abs(float(vo) - float(ve)) > 0.05:
        print(0); raise SystemExit()
print(f'{2000000.0 / dt:.1f}')
"
